findings.why_it_matters: 15.61.3 PRESENT-VALUE returned-value rule 1 b) and c): the printed subscripts 1, 2, n and i on argument-2 (denoting the first, second, n-th and i-th occurrence of argument-2) were flattened onto the baseline, so the equivalent arithmetic expressions read as references to nonexistent operands named argument-21, argument-22, argument-2n and argument-2i.
